review_method: Opened optimized mosaic overview and all 21 final lossless comparison PNG windows in the image viewer. All sample windows were viewed at original pixel resolution.
observations: Overview shows photographic wall, cracks, repair polygons, graffiti and construction seams; no large interior blank area seen. Serrated black outer coverage lies around the image boundary.
The optimized sample panels preserve continuous crack branches, polygon borders, construction seams and graffiti strokes; pose-only panels show much larger boundary offsets.
Some hard-cut brightness boundaries and rendering blur relative to immutable albedo remain visible. This is not a claim of photometrically seamless or truth-identical reconstruction.

Hard-cut intersections within samples were inspected; the separate full-raster automated seam test evaluates 4554397 hard-cut adjacencies. No claim of manually reviewing every seam or selecting global worst seams.

coverage_scope.note: Outside-region uncovered pixels are explicitly retained in diagnostic_inspection_summary.json; this is not full-wall coverage.
